primitive.relation: definitional equality: Extremal D2chr's frac_clique_minor B w r (the clique-minor LP as repaired in wave E10, e61d308: non-negative weights, NON-EMPTY connected branch sets, distinct indices adjacent, every vertex covered by weight at most 1, r the total weight) and is_fractional_hadwiger G r (its attained maximum) are Extremal.foundations.fractional_hadwiger.frac_clique_minor B w r and .is_fractional_hadwiger G r, with no guard on G (the empty graph has value 0, every value is at most #|G|). The value is unique; its existence for every finite graph is the LP attainment theorem Atlas.foundations.fractional.frac_hadwiger_exists. Distinct and not migrated: the integer Hadwiger number is_hadwiger, the pre-E10 defective body grounding_D2chr.old_frac_clique_minor (historical record), Atlas's local bramble LP hopt.

clique-minor-lp-feasible-point.note: frac_clique_minor B w r over an indexed family of branch sets B : 'I_n -> {set G} and rational weights w: the repaired (post-E10) feasibility predicate with its value r; D2chr keeps its name as a transparent alias.

attained-fractional-hadwiger-number.note: is_fractional_hadwiger G r over a rational r: attainment (some feasible point of value r) and maximality (every feasible value at most r); D2chr keeps its name as a transparent alias.

upstream_audit.note: The pinned GraphTheory and MathComp have no fractional Hadwiger number or clique-minor LP (the fractional-chromatic audit's in-image search for fractional / hadwiger: 0 files); GraphTheory's minor/minor_rmap is the integral notion. Ownership rule 4: used by one area (Extremal: the D2chr row and its grounding) and by Atlas foundations; placed in an Extremal area foundation next to fractional_colouring, over GTBase connected only (no minor import, so no package cycle).
